$description: Shared physics: productive motion is global and unmodulated; expressive motion takes each world's scale, easing and decay; every role and every world's expressive motion has a designed reduced form.

feedback.$description: Acknowledgement and feedback: hover, press and small state changes answering input.

result.$description: Selection-indicator move; result content replaces instantly.

hold.$description: Destructive hold: how long a press is held before an irreversible removal completes.

expressive.$description: Base expressive duration (material events, islands). Multiplied by world.motion.expressive-scale; never gates a destination.

preview-select.$description: Coordinated selection, premise opening and image crossfade in a directory preview.

preview-art.$description: Image settling inside the fixed directory preview frame.

bookmark.$description: Coordinated bookmark lift, colour bloom and shaped shadow change.

preview.$description: Hover intent before a reference preview opens; focus opens it immediately.

preview-warm.$description: After a preview closes, a neighbouring trigger within this time opens at once.

stagger.$description: Productive step between successive elements of a cascade whose order is information; used as read by productive roles, and multiplied by world.motion.expressive-scale for an expressive stagger. Never applied to a list the reader scans.

quote-autoplay.$description: Time between automatic testimony advances while unattended; the consumer disables autoplay for reduced motion.

quote-wheel-lock.$description: Minimum interval between wheel-requested testimony advances.

process-step.$description: Reading interval before an explicitly enabled process accordion advances to the next stage.

productive.$description: The one damped family for every productive role.

move.$description: Symmetric ease-in-out for movement between two on-screen positions.

preview-open.$description: A directory premise opens and its selected image settles without overshoot.

preview-fade.$description: Surface and image opacity exchange in a directory preview.

bookmark.$description: Bookmark colour and shadow response; fallback curve for its sampled lift.

scale.$description: Transform scales of productive motion; near 1, never 0.

press.$description: The control's drawing on press, about its own centre.

enter.$description: The scale a surface enters from and leaves toward, with opacity.

bookmark-art.$description: Artwork approach through the held bookmark colour bloom.

preview-art.$description: Resting overscan of an unselected directory image.

productive.$description: Blur a productive crossfade passes through while two states cross.

spring.$description: Springs for Motion consumers, in Motion's visual-duration and bounce parameters; the build also emits each as a CSS linear() easing with its duration.

productive.$description: The one productive spring: damped, no bounce; the spring form of easing.productive.

reduced.$description: The reduced form of each role: no spatial travel, and the state still lands through opacity, light and tone. Springs and eased travel give way to motion.reduced.easing over the role's reduced duration.

feedback.$description: Instant state change: press and hover change form, emphasis or light at once.

preview.$description: Brief opacity step in place; no travel or scale.

enter.$description: Shell entrance as a brief opacity step; the veil and shell appear in place.

leave.$description: Dismissal is instant; focus returns at once.

result.$description: Reduced equivalent of the selection-indicator move: the indicator changes state instantly.

sequence.$description: Chapter expansion opens at its final geometry.

expressive.$description: Base of an expressive moment without travel: light changes or material clears in place. Multiplied by world.motion.reduced.expressive-scale.

stagger.$description: No cascade: the elements appear together in their final order.

decay.$description: Emission release as a brief opacity step; light appears and releases without travel or bloom animation.

hold.$description: The same hold; progress shows without travel.

press-scale.$description: No press transform; emphasis or a tone step carries the press.

enter-scale.$description: Surfaces appear at full size; opacity carries the entrance.

blur.$description: No blur; states crossfade by opacity alone.

easing.$description: The one curve of every reduced step, standing in for easing.productive, easing.move and the productive spring.

preview-select.$description: The selected directory premise and image appear immediately.

preview-art.$description: The directory image rests without settling travel.

preview-art-scale.$description: The selected directory image holds its complete resting crop.

preview-lift.$description: The selected directory premise is immediately in its resting position.

bookmark.$description: Bookmark state changes immediately through colour without travel.

bookmark-lift.$description: Held bookmark remains seated while its material changes.

focus-reveal.$description: Complete heading without focus travel or optical obscuring.

encounter-choice.$description: Supporting choice holds its shape; border and action tone answer immediately without travel.

search-pond-pace.$description: Search pond retains a still field when motion is reduced.

process-accordion-media-scale.$description: Process illustration changes without scale travel in reduced motion.

preview-lift.$description: Premise entry displacement inside a directory choice.

bounce.$description: Damping of the bookmark lift response.

samples.$description: Intervals in the sampled bookmark lift response.

lift.$description: Upward travel of the held bookmark.

accordion-media-scale.$description: Scale of the process illustration while its content changes.

travel.$description: Word focus frame travel and optical transition.

dwell.$description: Clear word hold between focus transitions.

easing.$description: Measured focus frame and word resolve together.

once-budget.$description: Maximum complete once-only heading pass, including final immediate clear; headings that need longer retain their complete static form.

easing.$description: Fan selection uses the shared movement response with a gentle start and finish.

fade.$description: Account previews fade while their distance changes.

choice.$description: Account choice mark expansion and emphasis.

lift.$description: Supporting choice rise under pointer inquiry.

peek-travel.$description: Decorative figure approach into its supporting card.

peek-duration.$description: Slower figure settling within the lifted choice.

material-duration.$description: Supporting choice border and action material response.

action-scale.$description: Supporting action expansion under pointer inquiry.

easing.$description: Quick approach followed by a long settling glide in a supporting choice.

search-pond-pace.$description: Reference movement pace for the search discovery pond.

glyph-cycle.$description: Interval of subtle character evolution while the computational portrait follows attention.

reveal-life.$description: Time for a pointer ripple to dissolve back into the portrait surface.

duration.$description: Time for a complete short typed premise; reduced motion exposes the complete text without a typing pass.
Response time for opt-in primary-action movement, independent of scene playback.
